name: Agent editor opens the seeded agent's Config tab
description: From /agents, click the seeded Security Reviewer card and confirm the editor route renders its Config tab. The card click is router.push to /agents/:id?tab=config, so waiting for 'tab=config' pins both the route and the active tab in one deterministic check. The Config tab surfaces the 'Configuration' h2 and the 'System prompt' field label — neither is CSS-uppercased, so wait --text uses the DOM casing (only the editor header's provider/model Badge is uppercased; it is never used as a locator). The click target is in view: the three seeded cards sit at the top of the page. Read-only: no save, no enable toggle, no delete — nothing mutates the agent and no model call happens.

steps.label: open the seeded Security Reviewer card
